variants.name: rag-retrieval-verification
variants.description: Per-requirement verification receipt for RAG provenance, hardened chat retrieval, and provider status transitions

notes: AG-UI provenance carries knowledge-base ID, document ID, and document name.
The browser scenario observes retrieved content, outgoing prompt context, a source badge, and the hover-card document name.
The chat path invokes the hardened pipeline and the structured audit event is captured by metadata name and fields.
SurrealKV and PostgreSQL status transitions were observed separately.
Independent artifact critic and judge both accepted the final candidate.
